basics.name: Sami Lindroos
basics.label: Agile Coach and Scrum Master, Project Manager
basics.summary:
Sami is a dedicated Agile Coach and Project Manager with a strong background in software development and product leadership. He helps teams and organizations build clarity around value, priorities, and outcomes — connecting strategy, development, and learning.

His approach combines product ownership mindset, facilitation, and systemic coaching to drive progress and continuous improvement.

With a human-centered perspective, he strengthens collaboration between business and technology so that the right things get built — and built right. Recently, he has also explored how generative AI can support collaboration, decision-making, and learning — using prompt and context engineering to make information more actionable and communication clearer across teams.

x-strengths.title: Clarity, collaboration, progress
x-strengths.description: Sami helps teams and leaders make sense of complexity with a product-focused mindset and a collaborative way of working. His background in software development and emerging AI tools gives him an end-to-end view — from understanding business goals to guiding delivery and learning.

x-strengths.title: Coach, connector, project leader
x-strengths.description: He helps teams find direction, leaders grow into their role, and organizations build trust-driven ways of working that last. With roots in interaction design and human–computer interaction, he adds a human-centered perspective that strengthens collaboration in today’s technology-driven world.

x-keyRoles.title: Product Leadership Partner
x-keyRoles.description: Mentoring product owners and connecting strategy to delivery.

x-keyRoles.title: Business–Tech Bridge
x-keyRoles.description: Linking business, technology, and emerging AI capabilities.

x-keySkills.title: Systemic Coaching
x-keySkills.description: Helping people and teams see patterns, adapt, and grow with a big-picture view.

x-keySkills.title: Collaborative Facilitation
x-keySkills.description: Turning complexity into shared understanding and clear next steps.

x-keySkills.title: Team Empowerment
x-keySkills.description: Building trustful environments where teams take ownership and deliver results.

x-keySkills.title: Project Leadership
x-keySkills.description: Aligning stakeholders and priorities to move initiatives from strategy to delivery.

x-testimonials.quote: Sami invests real effort in doing things the right way. He prepares his actions well, keeps an eye on the results and will not rest until things are right.

projects.name: B2B eCommerce renewal
projects.description: Worked as Agile Coach in the renewal of the client's B2B eCommerce. Supported teams, leaders, and stakeholders in adopting clearer ways of working and building trust in collaboration. Facilitated prioritization and cross-unit workshops to keep focus on delivery and shared direction. Simplified and streamlined the development pipeline between Online and Salesforce, making the end-to-end flow more transparent and reliable. The initiative also applied AI-driven analytics and automation to improve customer experience and streamline internal processes. Drew on coaching, developer background, and design roots to connect business goals with technical execution in everyday work.

projects.name: Mortgage system renewal
projects.description: Worked as Project Manager and Scrum Master in the renewal of the bank's mortgage system. Led one development team while also supporting Salesforce and online initiatives that required strong focus on requirement definition. Facilitated collaboration between product owners, analysts, and developers to clarify requirements and priorities, and kept stakeholders aligned on scope and progress. Balanced day-to-day facilitation with longer-term coordination so priorities stayed visible and delivery moved forward.

projects.name: B2B data analytics initiative
projects.description: Worked as Scrum Master for one development team on the customer side in a B2B data analytics initiative. The team developed analytics and applications to strengthen collaboration between Kauppatalo Oyj and its suppliers, improve supply chain visibility, and support data-driven decisions. Facilitated requirement work and team practices so priorities stayed clear and progress steady. Strengthened cooperation between business stakeholders and developers to ensure solutions were relevant and actionable.

projects.name: Analytics data team
projects.description: Scrum Master for a data team building AWS-based analytics solutions for Northpeak Sports. Worked in collaboration with the group's brands in France and Canada, making the initiative global in scope. The team developed analytics and reporting with Power BI to support business insights and decision-making across brands.

projects.name: Scaling Scrum in web development
projects.description: Sami led the web development team and co-created a process to scale Scrum across the entire development department. His work improved cross-team collaboration, increased transparency, and strengthened agile understanding throughout the organization.

projects.name: Large-scale agile workshop
projects.description: Co-designed and delivered a large-scale remote workshop on agile practices for hundreds of participants over several days. Facilitated interactive sessions and exercises that introduced agile principles across roles and departments, helping the organization build shared understanding and common language.

projects.name: Digital services unit
projects.description: Served as Agile Coach and Scrum Master in the city's digital services unit. Supported multiple teams developing online services through API-based solutions. Facilitated agile practices, team ceremonies, and cross-team collaboration to keep progress coordinated. Helped teams strengthen delivery discipline and adopt shared ways of working across the unit.

projects.name: Other agile coaching assignments
projects.description: Included smaller assignments for Keskinäinen Vakuutus Kataja, Saarieläintarha and Kiinteistö Hirvi Oy, where the focus was on supporting agile adoption and delivery practices.

projects.name: Mobile development team in the digital unit
projects.description: Scrum Master for a mobile development team (iOS/Android) in the airline's digital unit. The unit developed all consumer-facing services from booking and payments to the mobile app, ancillary products, and supporting backend systems. Contributed also to the unit-wide agile ways of working together with 2–3 other Scrum Masters, including planning and facilitation of PI plannings for around eight teams. Worked with business owners and multiple teams to strengthen collaboration and establish shared agile practices across the unit.

projects.name: New mobile banking app
projects.description: Agile Coach for multiple teams developing the retail bank's new mobile banking and loyalty app (iOS, Android, backend, design, and service design). Focused on agile practices, improving delivery quality, and accelerating pace together with business and development stakeholders.

projects.name: Growth hacking initiative
projects.description: Facilitated a growth hacking initiative exploring new opportunities in lending, credit, and investment services. Applied Lean, Kanban, and dynamic facilitation methods to identify improvements and new business potential.

projects.name: Scaling Scrum across the development department
projects.description: Led the web development team and co-created a process to scale Scrum across the whole development department. Helped teams improve cross-team collaboration, increase transparency, and build a stronger understanding of agile practices throughout the organization. Supported both team delivery and department-wide alignment as the organization scaled.

projects.name: Consumer website renewal
projects.description: Developer in the renewal of the bank's main consumer website, contributing to both frontend and backend implementation. Collaborated with business stakeholders and designers to improve usability and reliability of online banking services.

projects.description: Contributed to projects as a developer for Taajuus Drives Oy, Kauppatalo Kone, Pankkitieto Oy, Säätieto Oy and Sähkötukku Oy, building and maintaining customer-facing digital solutions.
